title: Hockey-puck devices on the shins

tellings.quote: And then they came for me. I was terrified. He kind of like reached up in the air with his long thin articulated arms [music] and he had this thing in his hand that looked like a flattened hockey puck and they put one on on the outside of each one of my shins and then I couldn't move my legs.

as_told.title: Puck-shaped discs on Jim's shins paralyze his legs

plain: In 1976, near Allagash, Maine, a man named Jim Weiner says he was taken aboard a craft, where a being with long, thin, jointed arms held up something that looked like a flattened hockey puck. According to Weiner, who tells it as his own experience, the beings put one of these on the outside of each of his shins, and then he could not move his legs. He describes being terrified, and the detail matters to him as a sign of how he was held still.
